body: This 144  Mercedes Sprinter Van showcases a stunning interior with dark-toned espresso wood and crisp white cabinets, exuding elegance and comfort. The spacious layout features a luxurious sink and sprayer, paired with comfortable bench seating perfect for dining and relaxation.

One of the standout features of this custom camper van is the automatic bed lift, providing effortless convenience to raise and lower the bed as needed. Beneath the bed, there is ample space to store mountain bikes, along with generous cabinet storage. Easy pull-out trays make accessing and transporting bikes a breeze, ensuring you’re always ready for your next adventure.

The bench seating cleverly houses a Laveo dry flush toilet, ensuring you have easy and discreet access when nature calls. The exterior of this camper van is equipped for rugged adventures, featuring a CA Tuned bumper, perimeter lighting, roof rack with side ladder, and a powerful light bar. All-terrain wheels and tires, Black Rhino USA D ring shackles, and an ARB air compressor with switch, air quick connect, hose, and attachments make this van ready for any terrain.
